items.title: Ek sakta hai biyabaan ki fiza qamosh hai
items.body:
Ek sakta hai biyabaan ki fiza qamosh hai
qaak par laashe pade hai karbala qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
subha ki ahle haram ko yaad aati hai azaa'n
waqte maghrib hai, shabeehe mustafa qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo humakna muskaaara aur lipatna shaah se
Asghare masoom ki har ek ada qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai sakina god me zainab ke aansu hai rawaa'n
soti hai masoom aur maa behawa qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shaheedo'n ke bhi laashe , laashaye sheh ke qareeb
qaafila saalar chup hai, qaafela qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dhua'n baaqi abhi hai, dher hai kuch raakh ke
sheh ke qaime jal chuke saari faza qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bediya'n hai paae abid me to gardan me hai touq
roti hai zanjeer lekin naqshe paa qamosh hai

items.title: Ay paalne waale
items.body:
ay paalne waale ay paalne waale
ay paalne waale mujhe baba se milaade
<<DIVIDER>>
jab baba sakina ke na maidan se laute
us waqt sakina ne kaha dasht may roke
hai koi jo baba ko mere aaj bachaale
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
din bhar meri aankhon ne yehi dekha hai manzar
jo bhi gaya maidan may aaya na palat kar
baba hai idhar tanha udhar shaam ka lashkar
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
din dhal gaya raat aagayi aur chaaya andhera
har dil may hai bas zulm o jafa khauf ka saaya
kya hone ko hai ye soch ke dil darta hai mera
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
pani jo gaye lene chacha jaan hamare
neendh aagayi unko bhi taraai ke kinare
pardes may jee paaungi mai kiske sahare
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
seene pe mujhe baba ke chain aata hai so kar
is ban may unhe haye kahan dhoondun mai jaa kar
bin baap ke ab neendh mujhe aayegi kyun kar
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek baar mere baba mujhe aake pukare
aagosh may ay kaash mujhe aake sulaade
ab lamhon may sab dard unhe apna batade
ay paalne waale...
<<DIVIDER>>
daanish suye maidan hi takti thi sakina
baba ki judaai may tadapti thi sakina
bas haaton ko phailake ye kehti thi sakina
ay paalne waale...
items.author: Danish

items.title: Bas hussain bas
items.body:
asghar ko qatl gaah may laye hussain jab
rote huwe faraat ne dekhe wo sukhe lab
asghar ke hont sukhe huwe pyas ke sabab
dekha to khud pukaar ke bola jahan tarab
ay jibraeel kehdo zara bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua bas hussain bas
<<DIVIDER>>
roze qalam pe arsh pe rote thay ambiya
hillay may teer jod raha tha jo hurmala
is imtihane sabr pe khud maut ne kaha
bano ke mehlekha ko bacha bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
eesa jigar figaar thay musa bhi ashk baar
yaqoob de rahe thay sada roke baar baar
karbobala may thi yahi ayoob ki pukaar
moo ko kaleja aane laga bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehte thay nooh apne safine ko chod kar
gardish may na aaye kahin phir se behrobar
sar ko jhukake kehte thay yun nusba chashme tar
manzar hai dard naak bada bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
salman apne taqte hawayi pe rote thay
yusuf ye zulm dekh ke behosh hote thay
dawood kashte kalb may ashkon ko botay thay
aadam ki aa rahi thi sada bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadpa jo teer khaake wo bano ka naunehaal
asghar ke khoon se chehra e sarwar huwa jo laal
kehne laga rasool se tab rab e zuljalaal
kahiye ke zakht had se bada bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab jo apne bachon ke marne pe chup rahi
jo waakif e mizaaj e shahe tashnakaam thi
us waqt uske sabr ki deewar gir gayi
boli gira ke sar se rida bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
umme rubaab jhoole se lipti ye kehti thi
ya rab mujhe azeez hai asghar ki zindagi
kuch bhi teri kaneez ne maanga nahi kabhi
de hukm sheh ko mere khuda bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhir rehaan azmi di rab ne ye sada
hai imtehan e sabr ki shabbir inteha
jibreel bole ab hai yahi marzi e khuda
karbobala se arsh pe aa bas hussain bas
ab imtehan khatm hua...
items.author: Rehaan Azmi

items.title: Bano ne kaha jaan se
items.body:
soona jangal ghor andhera asghar aaja paas
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ne kaha jaan se pyare ali asghar
kya sogaye darya ke kanare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
tum paas thay mere to laga rehta tha jee bhi
tanhai may maa kisko pukare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jiski amaanat thay gaye paas usi ke
kyun chut'te agar hote hamare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dhoop ki shiddat se din kat gaya lekin
kis tarah se maa raat guzare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
aajao to jee bhar ke tumhe pani pila laaun
yan kyun hai chacha nehr kanare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar hai na qasim hai na ab aun o mohamad
sab toot chuke mere sahare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
din dhal gaya raat aa gayi darr lagta hai beta
phir koi shaqi teer na maare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek lamhe ko phir qaime may aajao ke maadar
wo khoon bhara kurta to utaare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
aagosh may tum hoge to shayad ye sitamgar
baandenge na phir haat hamare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
kohraam tha izzat lab e bano pa buka thi
aajao ke maa jaan ko waare ali asghar
pyare ali asghar
items.author: Izzat Lakhnavi
